pull_request.title: Infrastructure: Standardize PR naming and conflict preservation
pull_request.head: infrastructure/pr-naming
pull_request.body:
PR titles now use the requested area prefixes: `Magnet System:`, `Tracker:`, `Calorimeter:`, `Muon System:`, `Global:`, `Software:` and `Infrastructure:`, followed by a nonempty description. AGENTS.md records the canonical rule, the PR template and project guide explain it, and CI checks exact spelling and capitalization on PR creation, pushes and title edits.

`Infrastructure:` replaces the old `chore:` convention while preserving the exclusion of maintenance from scientific progress tracking. Scientific work cannot bypass tracking through this prefix; historical chore records remain supported. The rule also records the default of preserving both independent logging/record contributions during conflict resolution, without duplicating IDs or usage observations or changing human approvals.

Applied to all four previously open PRs:

- #6: **Magnet System: Evaluate magnetic layouts with candidate-specific muon envelopes**
- #8: **Tracker: Propose reusable RD53i modules with component material accounts**
- #13: **Tracker: Study tracker layouts and inclined modules with independent controls**
- #14: **Software: Assess pyacts Gen-3 module geometry and propagation bindings**

Only #8 conflicted with main. Its branch now contains ordinary merge `84f23f3f58cd289b90b9ac759efdc0e51dceb97b`, preserving both documentation entries, independent tracking/review records and all session logs. DES-001/ADR-007 content and all original review records remain unchanged. All four PRs now report MERGEABLE/CLEAN. No PR was merged into main and tracker-layout work remains on hold.

Validation: 26 dashboard/update-policy tests, 15 logging/document-link tests, 14 JavaScript assertions, session validation and dashboard build passed. PR #8 separately passed 25 dashboard and 15 logging tests, dashboard build/validation and record-preservation checks. Curated session records retain commands, limitations and the conflict-resolution outcome.

events.text: Standardize PR titles and reconcile open branch conflicts — see the canonical narrative for outcomes and checks.

Create a new workflow rule about naming of the PRs.

Name them:

"Magnet System: <description>"
"Tracker: <description>"
"Calorimeter: <description>"
"Muon System: ..."
"Global: " (e.g. envelope design)
"Software: " (to have new software skills)
"Infrastructure: " (like this one)

Record this rule and apply it to open PRs, also - if there are conflicts - try to resolve them, they are mostly in the logging files, where accepting both changes is the default.
